notes.title: New Events
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 New Events & Mini-Games Devlog 🎮[/h2][p]Hello Bosses! 👔
In today’s devlog, we’re introducing a brand-new [b]event system[/b] that will make office life more fun and colorful! With this new update, you can now organize [b]various events for your employees[/b], boost their [b]happiness[/b], and reduce their [b]stress levels[/b]! 🌈[/p][h3]🧠 Interactive Mini-Games![/h3][p]Some events aren’t just visual — they transform into fun [b]mini-games[/b]!
Through these mini-games, you can [b]motivate your employees[/b] and directly [b]increase productivity[/b]. Each game adds a unique touch to the everyday office routine![/p][h3]😊 Boost Employee Happiness[/h3][p]With events, you can:[/p][list][*][p]📈 Increase productivity[/p][/*][*][p]💆 Reduce stress[/p][/*][*][p]🎭 Brighten up the office atmosphere[/p][/*][/list][p]Being a good boss isn’t just about assigning tasks — it’s about caring for your team’s well-being. These events help you do just that![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🍔 Burger Day[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/78a2b6264c48f1f0833091d8b468c80cbaf60f76.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎭 Theatre Day[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/c865923309c14365b28a7711d6039bc1d936064d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎨 Art Day[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/04d734741ea390373b5bb31e705f8f5b7106d5d7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧘 Yoga Day[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/6722216cd6a8c5369d1191ed7973f527af1eff9d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎬 Cinema Day[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/b08bb5c83ad376b406c7a822e10755755323e365.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]⏰ Don’t Miss the Happy Hours![/h3][p]Scheduled [b]Happy Hour[/b] events are a great morale boost for the whole office! 🎊
Time them wisely, and keep your team energized![/p][h3]🚧 More Events Coming Soon![/h3][p]This is just the beginning!
We're currently working on [b]new events[/b], [b]more mini-games[/b], and [b]surprise content[/b] that will be added in future updates. Stay tuned![/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 Don’t forget to leave your feedback in the comments! We’d love to include your ideas in future content.
Be a good boss, and transform your office vibe! 🏢🌟[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer, New Rooms & More – Devlog 2
notes.content:
[h2]🎥 New In-Game Video Released![/h2][p]We're excited to share a brand-new video captured directly from gameplay! With improved UI, animations, and systems, you can now get a much closer look at the current state of the game. Don’t miss it![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sANaxeemzRA;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 "Make Game" Screen Completely Revamped[/h2][p]We've completely redesigned the "Make Game" screen to be more detailed and strategic. Now, when choosing the game genre, target audience, platforms, and more, you’ll have deeper control over development.
Your choices will directly impact whether your game becomes a trend or not — influencing its rating, number of downloads, and the revenue you earn. A truly immersive game development experience awaits![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/09e6346fcc4a75432a1803a2d5d8a1809a12e0c8.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌳 Skill Tree Updated[/h2][p]We’ve made a comprehensive overhaul of the skill tree to make it more strategic and rewarding. Now, every choice you make has a greater impact on the future of your company![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/3f8a703d3965abf7bf301481b22ebd1728be6712.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]💸 Pricing System & Publisher Partnerships[/h2][p]You can now set prices for the games you create and earn revenue from them. On top of that, a new system allows you to collaborate with publishers to launch your games! A realistic marketing experience is now part of the gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/6a0431131f25659fe80a52a4457aeda0304f229f.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🏢 New Rooms Unlocked[/h2][p]You can now expand your office with new rooms, each serving different functions to diversify your company. These content-rich additions will directly influence your game development process![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/c35bc8cc44ad864270fe723db01a03211d1c106b.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]⬆️ Expand Your Company Space[/h2][p]The office expansion feature is now live! Move into a larger space, build more teams, and take on bigger projects. It’s time to turn your company into a massive game development studio![/p][p][/p][h2]🖼️ A Few In-Game Screenshots[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/b24b21ccecef7bf30becea450b30ed53f7a102d4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/8205efd51589d5755443e3317b55282e72f5a600.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/88243952d8a5e9f74a409054f52d1d1524c5b742.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194922/072d393bf05c11e27d5f0d7e5008ab9c5f792943.png"][/img][/p]
